model_annotation: Both panels are line plots showing training rewards as a function of steps, with a shared x-axis labeled “Steps” on a linear scale from 0 to 500 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis in both panels is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top panel it spans roughly 0.0 to about 0.4+ with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4, while in the bottom panel it spans roughly 0.0 to about 0.2 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. In the top panel titled “Easy Training Set,” there are two solid lines with no visible markers: a teal line (“Llama-On-Policy-Easy”) and a red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Easy”). Both start near 0 at step 0; the teal line rises to around 0.25 by roughly 100 steps, fluctuates in the 0.30–0.38 range through the mid-training region, and ends near about 0.35–0.37 by step 500, while the red line rises to around 0.20–0.25 by roughly 100 steps, continues upward with fluctuations around 0.30–0.40, and ends near about 0.42–0.44 at step 500. In the bottom panel titled “Hard Training Set,” there are again two solid lines with no visible markers: a teal line (“Llama-On-Policy-Hard”) and an orange line (“Llama-LUFFY-Hard”). The teal line begins slightly above 0 (around a few hundredths) near step 0, trends downward toward 0 by around 50–100 steps, and remains approximately at 0 for the rest of the x-range to step 500, whereas the orange line starts near 0 at step 0, rises to about 0.10 by roughly 100 steps, continues increasing with small oscillations (around 0.13–0.17 across the middle steps), and reaches approximately 0.20 by step 500.
